name: Basewright: Preflight
description: Ask whether a host can carry the instance somebody wants, before anything is touched. Changes nothing. A blocking rule ends the task red, and the log names the rule, what was found, what was required, and what would have to change.

survey_vars.name: basewright_hosts
survey_vars.title: Host
survey_vars.description: The host to read, as the inventory names it. One host, or an inventory group.

survey_vars.name: basewright_engine_name
survey_vars.title: Engine
survey_vars.description: Which database engine is being provisioned. The values are the directories under profiles/.

survey_vars.name: basewright_version
survey_vars.title: Engine version
survey_vars.description: Leave empty to take the profile's default. A version somebody chose and a version nobody chose are different decisions, and one of the rules reads which it was.

survey_vars.name: basewright_instance
survey_vars.title: Instance name
survey_vars.description: Leave empty to take the profile's default. Names the cluster, its paths and its unit.
